title.text: Did pay keep up with prices in Ireland, 2015–2025?
subtitle: •  From 2015 to 2025 pay rose 44% and prices 22%: a week's pay buys 18% more.
•  From Q3 2021 to Q3 2023 inflation cut real pay by 7%; the pay of only 2 of 17 sectors kept up with prices.
•  Housing & energy prices rose 70%, far faster than pay.
